name: claude
description: Use Claude Code from Codex: rescue tasks, Claude's built-in review, adversarial review, and an optional stop-time review gate, through the local `claude` CLI. Port of openai/codex-plugin-cc with roles swapped.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Claude Code for a second opinion or a review
interface.longDescription: Runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI in headless mode. Claude reads the repository (read-only by default) and its answer comes back to Codex. Supports background jobs and resuming the last Claude session per repository.
